numeric_contract: 0 to 1 declared PI ordinal judgments; not posterior probabilities or validated metric intervals. E is source relevance/quality and may be high for a claim being refuted. G global transfer, C local warrant, L continue/adopt.

evidence.scope: MQR 4.95 audited full GBIF 2024 row/source status ancestry
evidence.limitation: Historical source-bound row and provider count audit; the source ZIP is not independently redownloaded this turn.

evidence.scope: MQR R107 source-identity in-sample classification diagnostic
evidence.limitation: Exact Git SHA and Python execution verified after fixing erroneous confusion marginal assertion; same data root as E01.

evidence.scope: MQR R108 occupancy/detection three-world hypothetical contrasts using source Spring counts
evidence.limitation: Exact Git SHA and Python execution verified; mathematically constructed worlds, no actual site repeats; same empirical count source as E01.

evidence.scope: GBIF data quality documentation: detection and sampling-event status
evidence.limitation: Official data-provider semantics, not independent observation of the Finnish population.

evidence.scope: MQR 4.97 independent original NAAMP 2001 repeated acoustic surveys
evidence.limitation: Genuine prior data root but different species/USA sites; not a repeat of GBIF Finland.

evidence.scope: MQR 4.98 Alder Flycatcher 2005 encounter histories and zero truncation
evidence.limitation: Real separate biological sampling root, but not same target sites or taxa as GBIF Finland.

evidence.scope: Phillips et al source selection bias and presence-only background prior-art paper
evidence.limitation: Abstract/search source used as prior-art pointer; not counted as full paper read or newly verified effect sizes.

claims_and_decisions.claim: Historic source-label 3x2 counts are reproduced faithfully from audited 4.95 receipt
claims_and_decisions.limitation: Original aggregate is grounded; no new raw retrieval

claims_and_decisions.claim: A retrospectively source-only classification of the same original statuses scores 26056/29543 in sample
claims_and_decisions.limitation: Outcome-informed rule, no independent validation or original classifier execution

claims_and_decisions.claim: Source identity caused true ecological occupancy differences
claims_and_decisions.limitation: Source protocol, field selection, geography and detection are confounded

claims_and_decisions.claim: Original authors' fitted classifier has learned a dataset-id shortcut
claims_and_decisions.limitation: No test of trained original model by source/environment out-of-domain heldout

claims_and_decisions.claim: Different occupancy and detection combinations can match source Spring observed single-visit prevalence
claims_and_decisions.limitation: Applies only to stipulated no-false-positive closed-site and independent-trial assumptions

claims_and_decisions.claim: Genuine stable same-site revisits can distinguish the three stipulated models from their predicted conditional rates
claims_and_decisions.limitation: The needed revisits were NOT obtained in R107/R108 and neither dataset provides same physical target transport

claims_and_decisions.claim: GBIF recorded ABSENT guarantees biological absence at a location independent of survey effort
claims_and_decisions.limitation: No detection is not logical proof of no organism; inference needs effort and sampling protocol

claims_and_decisions.claim: Shared numeric code across two independent providers implies identical native observational operation
claims_and_decisions.limitation: GBIF standard maps diverse source practices into one field; same status tokens insufficient

claims_and_decisions.claim: Our source-only and q*d observation is method-theoretically novel beyond existing SDM / occupancy prior art
claims_and_decisions.limitation: Existing detection and selection bias techniques already predict the general caution

claims_and_decisions.claim: Use provider-specific exact status audit as physical-world anchored Q2 limited example, without alien-science proof
claims_and_decisions.limitation: Cross-practice label alignment relevant; no native-language spontaneous bridge

claims_and_decisions.claim: Require genuine same-target repeated detection and source-blind baselines before any world-facing Q7 difference claim
claims_and_decisions.limitation: Current matched same physical target experiment absent; competing established protocols set benchmark

claims_and_decisions.claim: Continue Faraday/Maxwell archival concept-generation comparison in parallel; no monolithic GBIF-only MQR
claims_and_decisions.limitation: Program director allocation; Faraday evidence is on independent R99–R105 ledger, not this source family.

source_independence_warning: E01 E02 E03 share one 2024 GBIF data root; calculating different statistics, writing new code and constructing alternative models do not create new original field observations.
